name: The Tides Inn
insider_take: This historic waterfront gem on Virginia's Northern Neck has been hosting guests since 1947, earning a reputation as the "Queen of Chesapeake Bay resorts."
whats_special: The Tides Inn sits on the scenic Rappahannock River where it meets the Chesapeake Bay, offering 480 acres of pristine waterfront. The resort features its own private beach, championship golf course designed by Sir Guy Campbell, and a fleet of vintage wooden boats. Notable guests have included Presidents Roosevelt, Truman, and Reagan, plus countless celebrities who've enjoyed the refined Southern hospitality.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cruise aboard the resort's classic yacht "Miss Ann" - it's been ferrying guests since the 1960s and offers the best views of the golden hour over the Chesapeake.
dont_miss: Take a day trip to nearby Christ Church (1735), one of America's best-preserved colonial churches, or explore the charming town of White Stone just 10 minutes away. The resort's location in Virginia's "Northern Neck" region puts you in the heart of where George Washington and Robert E. Lee were born, with several historic plantations within easy driving distance.
pros: Historic waterfront resort on the Rappahannock River
Full-service marina with yacht and sailboat access
Multiple dining venues with river views
cons: Remote location in Northern Neck region
Seasonal property with limited winter operations
